G3/TC-775: confirmed real, not a measurement artifact - Proto's rendered text (hundreds of XFA child-element accessor methods) exceeds infra/build_chunks.py's MAX_CHUNK_TEXT_CHARS (24,000) cap, and that script's _sanitize_chunk_text truncation cuts the text before it reaches the trailing API-Coverage line chunk_builder._format_type_text always appends last. A genuine extraction/build-pipeline defect (any sufficiently large chunk can silently lose its coverage disclosure the same way); its real fix lives in infra/build_chunks.py, outside this card's write_paths, so it is recorded here and flagged for a focused follow-up card rather than forced into this one's scope. Confirmed isolated: this is the only such gap across every symbol chunk of all 32 real baked pilots.
